{{Quote|Two Rodians were talking about one of the employees, and how if that was a human, he'd eat his &hellip; I couldn't hear the next words, but we've all heard about ooglith masquers, and how the Yuuzhan Vong can pass as human.|Tekli, on the Yuuzhan Vong|<ref name="Balance Point" />}}
A '''Yuuzhan Vong''' [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] worked at the [[Leafy Green]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] while undercover on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While there, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[ooglith masquer]] cover was blown after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tekli]] overheard two patrons express their suspicions that she was not [[Human/Legends|Human]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and her nephew [[Anakin Solo]] went to the Leafy Green and apprehended her after a brief altercation. Although New Republic [[Medic/Legends|medics]] examined the captive to learn more about Yuuzhan Vong biology, at the first opportunity she [[Death/Legends|killed]] herself to prevent further discoveries.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You took one Yuuzhan Vong operative out of commission, and found a way to kill the amphistaffs.''"<br />"''Not enough.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Mara Jade Skywalker, on her encounter with the Yuuzhan Vong|<ref name="Balance Point" />}}
In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]<ref name="TERC" /> during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Yuuzhan Vong took an undercover assignment as [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There, she worked at the [[Leafy Green]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] until the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tekli]] overheard two patrons at the establishment express suspicions that she was not [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Recalling the Yuuzhan Vong ability to disguise themselves as Human using [[ooglith masquer]]s, Tekli reported her suspicions during a meeting of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. Two Jedi, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and her nephew [[Anakin Solo]], went to investigate the lead. Determining through their inability to sense her through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that she was indeed a Yuuzhan Vong saboteur, they confronted the Yuuzhan Vong and apprehended her after a fight. During the fight, Jade Skywalker and Solo discovered a way to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[amphistaff]] creatures that the Yuuzhan Vong employed as weapons.<ref name="Balance Point" />

New Republic [[Medic/Legends|medics]] examined the [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] Yuuzhan Vong in the hopes of learning more about the biology of the [[Species/Legends|species]]. However, rather than allow the New Republic to learn anything more from her about her people, the Yuuzhan Vong killed herself at the first opportunity. The untimely death frustrated Jade Skywalker, who felt that it wasn't enough and she should have done better.<ref name="Balance Point" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|She didn't have as many bone breaks or scars as the ones they scanned on Bimmiel.''"<br />"''That isn't hard to figure out. They give low-ranking youngsters undercover work to prove themselves.|Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade Skywalker|<ref name="Balance Point" />}}
The Yuuzhan Vong had [[Color/Legends|pale]] skin with bluish sacs below each [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and patchy black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that grew in tufts across her skull. Her face had little flesh on it and one upper cheek was burned all almost through, forming a scar that revealed a [[Bone/Legends|cheekbone]] covered in jagged, healed fractures. The Yuuzhan Vong had [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] shaped like concentric energy bursts across her forehead, and half of her body was tattooed with similar concentric designs meeting at a focal point that vaguely resembled a living creature. She had extendable claws protruding from the knuckles of each hand, formed from a parasitic Yuuzhan Vong creature embedded deep into the bone. Because she had fewer bone breaks and scars than<ref name="Balance Point" /> the [[Domain Shai]] [[Warrior caste|warriors]]<ref name="Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> scanned at [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]], Jade Skywalker surmised she was a younger, low-ranking Yuuzhan Vong who was given undercover work to prove herself. Though female, according to the examinations performed by New Republic medics, the Yuuzhan Vong's ooglith masquer disguise had the appearance of a pale, Human male. The unnatural way she carried herself while wearing the masquer led some members of other species, including Rodians and Humans, to doubt that she was truly Human.<ref name="Balance Point" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I know you know Basic.|Mara Jade Skywalker|<ref name="Balance Point" />}}
As a Yuuzhan Vong operative, she could fight using an amphistaff and other biological weaponry of her species, including [[blorash jelly]]. She also knew [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]] and used the [[Language/Legends|language]] when working at the Leafy Green.<ref name="Balance Point" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|He's not wearing armor, just the masquer.|Anakin Solo|<ref name="Balance Point" />}}
While in Human disguise, the Yuuzhan Vong wore the uniform for servers at the Leafy Green restaurant. This included pants and a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] from which she carried a pouch of blorash jelly. She carried an amphistaff concealed up one sleeve, but did not wear any [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="Balance Point" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuuzhan Vong first appeared in the [[2000]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'', written by [[Kathy Tyers]].<ref name="Balance Point" />
